title: Ugreen’s new desktop charger can deliver 240W to power-hungry laptops.
summary: What sets Ugreen’s new $199.99 Nexode Pro 300W apart is that in addition to six USB-C charging ports and a USB-A port, it includes a barrel-style port that can deliver 240W to a beefy laptop.
